# FG-LLM-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`llm-advice-quality`](../../ops/runbooks/llm-advice-quality.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_refused_draft_writes_no_branch` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: AI の修正の下書きは作りませんでした（提案が決まりの外でした）。改善要求の MR はそのままです。
- en: No AI draft fix was made (the proposal was outside the rules). The improvement merge request is unchanged.
- id: Draf perbaikan AI tidak dibuat (usulan di luar aturan). Merge request perbaikan tidak berubah.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 P17-10 (ADR-0039 Amendment P17-10): the worker's AI asset draft (`asset_draft`) asked the local LLM to propose a fix of a skill or a playbook for a draft improvement merge request (`improve/<id>` in a project with `ai_assets.enabled`), and committed nothing to `ai-draft/<id>`. `reason`: `no_edit` (the answer proposed no acceptable file: every edit named a file the input did not give, an empty, unchanged or oversized content, a redaction marker, or none at all — `dropped` counts them), `not_editable` (a kept edit is not an unprotected `skills/*.md` / `playbooks/*.toml` of the request's outlet), `numbers_changed` (the proposal changes a number of the file: judgement thresholds are people's), `new_link` / `new_mention` (it adds a link or an `@mention` the file did not have: injected text), `secret` (the proposed content holds a secret-looking value), `path_refused` (git refused the path). The merge request, its branch and its draft state are never touched; the advice (the model's reasons) is kept on the merge request as usual.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs it once per merge request and input with `task=asset_draft`, `project_id`, `merge_request_id`, `llm_request_id`, `reason`, `dropped` and `path` (when one edit is named). Read the request and its advice: SELECT r.state, r.prompt_version, a.summary, a.degraded FROM forge.llm_requests r LEFT JOIN forge.llm_advice a ON a.llm_request_id = r.id WHERE r.id = <llm_request_id>. Many `no_edit` after a prompt or model change are the change's fault; `secret` means the model wrote a credential-looking value (from the case text: the case should not hold one).

## 対処 (fix)

Single ones need nothing: a person fixes the asset by hand (plan 17 §1.5). A run of `no_edit` after a prompt or model change: roll it back (runbook llm-advice-quality) and add the case to the eval set `crates/forge-llm/evals/ai_asset_draft/`. `secret`: check the case for a credential (a committed secret is a leak: runbook secret-removal).
